name: envforge
description: Linux environment migration, rebuild, verification, and rollback platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @fool/core && npm run build --workspace @fool/collectors && npm run build --workspace @fool/restorers && npm run build --workspace @fool/cli && npm run build --workspace @fool/api && npm run build --workspace @fool/web
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace @fool/core && npm run build --workspace @fool/collectors && npm run build --workspace @fool/restorers && npm run build --workspace @fool/api
scripts.catalog:audit: npm run build:server && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('artifacts/generated/catalog',{recursive:true})" && node scripts/audit-catalog-items.mjs > artifacts/generated/catalog/catalog-items.dump.json
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:server && npm run start --workspace @fool/api
scripts.db:migrate:phase0: npm run build:server && npm run platform:migrate --workspace @fool/api
scripts.start:platform-worker: npm run build:server && npm run platform:worker --workspace @fool/api
scripts.start:platform-projection: npm run build:server && npm run platform:projection --workspace @fool/api
scripts.migration:phase0:dry-run: npm run build:server && npm run platform:backfill:dry-run --workspace @fool/api
scripts.migration:phase0:apply: npm run build:server && npm run platform:backfill:apply --workspace @fool/api
scripts.backup:postgres:phase0: npm run build:server && npm run platform:backup --workspace @fool/api
scripts.restore:postgres:phase0: npm run build:server && npm run platform:restore --workspace @fool/api
scripts.validate:design: npm run validate:docs:static && npm run validate:docs:markdown && npm run validate:docs:mermaid && npm run validate:openapi && npm run validate:schemas
scripts.validate:preparation: npm run validate:design && npm run validate:ddl && npm run validate:preparation:security && npm run validate:preparation:failure-paths
